note: W6: Incremental Verifier State Maintenance across Epoch Chains. Models O(1) verifier memory (72 B) maintaining Merkle root and sequence chain across N=66 epochs. Certified D6 compliant.

controls.name: C_incremental_matches_full_rebuild
controls.must_fire_because: incrementally maintained root must exactly match full trie rebuild at every epoch
controls.can_fail_because: if apply_insert or fold had an incorrect divergence case
controls.null_must_contain: a divergence between fold-forward and full rebuild

controls.name: C_constant_verifier_memory
controls.must_fire_because: verifier resident memory must remain strictly 72 bytes across all epochs
controls.can_fail_because: if verifier retained prior atoms or subtrie nodes in memory
controls.null_must_contain: growing verifier memory with space size

controls.name: C_cumulative_bandwidth_beats_full_sync
controls.must_fire_because: cumulative witness bandwidth must be strictly less than cumulative full sync bandwidth
controls.can_fail_because: if authentication path overhead exceeded cumulative full trie transfers
controls.null_must_contain: witness proofs larger than cumulative full space payloads

controls.name: C_corrupted_delta_rejected_atomically
controls.must_fire_because: verifier must reject corrupted delta proofs and maintain unmutated root
controls.can_fail_because: if non-membership verification failed to detect modified step digests

controls.name: C_out_of_order_epoch_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: applying an epoch delta proof against a mismatched predecessor root must fail
controls.can_fail_because: if verify_insert did not bind the exact root predecessor
controls.null_must_contain: epoch proofs valid across different predecessor states

controls.name: C_sequence_chain_bound
controls.must_fire_because: verifier sequence chain heads must be strictly tracked across all 66 epochs
controls.can_fail_because: if chain_step was omitted or disconnected from root advance

controls.name: C_query_on_incremental_root
controls.must_fire_because: incremental root must verify downstream membership, non-membership, and completeness queries
controls.can_fail_because: if folded root differed from honest trie state
controls.null_must_contain: failing queries on incrementally folded root

falsifiers.name: F_no_memory_advantage
falsifiers.can_fail_because: verifier memory > 128 bytes or cumulative witness bandwidth >= full sync bandwidth at N >= 20 epochs
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a verifier whose memory scales with space size
falsifiers.refutes: that incremental witnessed verification provides O(1) memory and sub-quadratic cumulative network scaling
falsifiers.fires_when: verifier memory > 128 bytes or cumulative witness bandwidth >= full sync bandwidth at N >= 20 epochs
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: Verifier resident memory exceeds 128 bytes, or cumulative witness bandwidth exceeds cumulative full sync bandwidth for N >= 20 epochs.
